open_questions: Multan Metrobus fare: Mar-2026 increase to Rs 40 (Rs 25 with Green Transport Card) reported by news; PMA website and safar.fyi still show Rs 25. Feeder fare after the increase unknown.

Multan feeder route codes (MFR01-MFR39) and stops come from safar.fyi only; PMA's website offers only a planning PDF with different numbering (routes 1-40). Operational feeder route count not confirmed by PMA.
Multan Green Electric Bus: only one EV route (Vehari Chowk - Nishtar Chowk) found (safar.fyi); no official route list, launch date or fare located.

Gujranwala city: 12 e-buses due by end-July 2026 but no launched Gujranwala-city routes found (only Wazirabad routes in Gujranwala district). Gujranwala Mass Transit (Yellow Line BRT) under construction - not included.
Faisalabad: seven e-bus routes reported at launch (Sep 2025) but only two identified. Faisalabad Metro (Red/Orange lines) planned - not included.
Murree route conflict: news names Kotli Sattian/17-Mile routes; safar.fyi lists Barrian, Rawat, New Murree (EVM01-03).

Exact launch dates unconfirmed for Mianwali, Muzaffargarh, Pakpattan, Sahiwal and the ten Nov-2025 cities (Chakwal, Jhelum, Gujar Khan, Toba Tek Singh, Jhang, Bahawalnagar, Rahim Yar Khan, Rajanpur, Bahawalpur); the Jul-2026 batch (Attock, Bhakkar, Hafizabad, Khanewal, Khushab, Mandi Bahauddin) reported ~6 Jul 2026.

District e-bus routes have no published official route codes (ids are slugs, except Murree EVM01-03). All district stop lists are one direction from safar.fyi and not verified against government sources; spellings are as published there.

Coordinates: all 21 Multan Metrobus stations from OSM; a handful of Multan feeder stops matched by exact OSM bus_stop name; every other stop null. overpass-api.de was unreachable, data came from a mirror (OSM base 2026-07-24).
Tehsil-level expansion from Jan 2027 (target 3,000 buses by Jun 2027; e.g. Multan 169, Bahawalpur 215, Faisalabad 202, Sargodha 198, Sahiwal 87, DG Khan 63) announced without routes - not included.
